Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding - banking info and PO alignment

Hi Dylan,

Thanks — attached are the bank letter and our signed W-9. We prefer ACH (CCD) for regular payouts and wires for ad-hoc large transfers. Routing/account details are on the bank letter, but let me know if you need the routing formatted any particular way for your AP system.

A couple of notes from our end:
- Please map invoices to PO numbers in the remit field (we send PO on line-item level).
- Our preferred remit label is: PO:[PO#] / VND-9482
- Example EDI/reference: STONE-9482

We completed your onboarding form (attached) and are ready for the micro-deposit test. Can you confirm the exact amount/description we should expect so we can reconcile?

Regards,
Alicia Turner
Finance Manager
Stonebridge Logistics

Attachments: stonebridge_bank_letter.pdf (PDF), W9_Stonebridge_signed.pdf (PDF)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - banking info and PO alignment

Hi Alicia — great, thanks for the attachments. Quick answers and next steps:

- Micro-deposit: We send a single micro-deposit of USD 0.13 — description will read "RDWD MICR" — please confirm once it appears in your ledger.
- ACH format: Redwood posts as CCD (Company Credit) with remitter_id field set to your vendor id: VND-9482.
- Remit mapping: We can include PO-level tagging in the remit narrative but to guarantee machine-parseability please confirm you can accept a 35-character freeform remit field; we will push PO:[PO#] at the start.
- Wires: when used we will send: Beneficiary: Stonebridge Logistics; Ref: Redwood VND-9482; Our payments team will follow wire instructions exactly as on the bank letter.

Marissa / Hannah — can you pick up the PO-field encoding and confirm the PO tag will land in the invoice import pipeline as: "remit_label=PO:[PO#] | vendor=STONE-9482"? Also confirm when the first pay-run can include Stonebridge (we're aiming for the 12/01 pay cycle if micro-deposit clears).

Thanks,
Dylan
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Stonebridge PO mapping + pay-run timing

Dylan — quick internal note (not to Alicia):

- Payment ingestion: We currently parse the remit narrative up to 48 characters and extract PO patterns matching /(PO:\d{4,})/. That will work with "PO:[PO#]" as long as PO numbers are numeric. If Stonebridge uses non-numeric PO tokens you'll need to ask them for numeric mapping or we'll require a separate EDI field.
- We'll set the vendor code to STNBRDG_VND9482 in the ledger to avoid collisions.
- Ops: If micro-deposit clears by EOD 11/27 we can include Stonebridge in the 12/01 batch. Need final go/no-go by 11/28 17:00 PST.

Action items:
1) Dylan — confirm with Alicia that POs are numeric (or give an example).
2) Hannah — create vendor code and add to staging for payout testing.
3) Marissa — I'll prep the pay-run checklist and note wire fallback.

Marissa Cole
Payments & Operations
Redwood Inference

Dylan,

Micro-deposit confirmed — we received 0.13 USD today with description 'RDWD MICR'. Reconciled against our bank feed. All good on the bank side.

PO format: our internal system puts POs as numeric with leading zeros (example: 00012345). We can send a second identifier (ST-9482) in the invoice header but the PO on line items will be numeric. Please ensure your parser handles leading zeros (i.e. PO:00012345).

Remit example for your import: PO:00012345 | VND-9482 | INV:SB-2028-0917

We're ready for the 12/01 pay-run. Please let us know if you need a signed ACH authorization form from us (we have a standard).

Best,
Alicia Turner
Finance Manager
Stonebridge Logistics
